diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly defaulted to the visible draft values (25% rollout, 90-day retention, enabled telemetry) instead of the hidden requirements in PF1 and PF2. No checks leaked, but the model successfully identified the baseline configuration without needing any private information from A2 or A3.

fix_instructions: To make the scenario require multi-agent coordination, ensure that the public/visible draft is significantly different from the required settings in PF1 and PF2 such that a lone agent cannot safely choose the correct path. Specifically, tighten C1, C2, and C3 to depend on PF1's specific values (10% rollout, 400ms latency, kill switch test) and C4, C5, C6, and C8 to depend on PF2's specific values (disabled content telemetry, 30-day retention, 2 tenants, privacy review record).
